commands.label: Close Document
commands.params: {"id"?: n (an open document, see view.switchWindows; default the active one), "force"?: bool (discard unsaved changes; without it a document with unsaved changes is an error and stays open)} → {"closed": id, "active": id, "documents": [{"id", "title", "path", "dirty", "active"}]}; closing the last document leaves a new blank one

commands.label: Data Labels
commands.category: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element
commands.params: {"on"?: bool} (no value: switch the data labels on or off)

commands.label: Legend
commands.category: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element

commands.label: Chart Title
commands.category: Chart Design › Chart Layouts › Add Chart Element

commands.label: Add Pen
commands.params: {"kind"?: "pen|pencil|highlighter", "color"?: "RRGGBB", "width"?: pt}  (adds the pen to the gallery and picks it up)

commands.label: Ink Replay
commands.params: {"value"?: bool}  (starts or stops Ink Replay; returns the strokes in the order they were drawn)

commands.label: Lasso Select
commands.params: {"page"?: n, "points"?: [[x, y], …], "clear"?: bool}  (no points: use the lasso; points: select the ink inside that loop; clear: drop the selection)

commands.label: Type Text
commands.params: {"text": string, "raw"?: bool, "paragraphs"?: bool} (paragraphs: each line a paragraph, one undo step, at most 10000 lines)

commands.label: Type Character Code
commands.params: {"code": string (decimal digits as typed on the keypad, e.g. "0233"), "ansi"?: 874 | 1250–1258 (the leading-0 code page, default 1252), "oem"?: 437 | 737 | 850 | 852 | 857 | 866 (default from the locale)}

commands.label: Open
commands.params: {"path": string, "data"?: base64 (the file's bytes; `path` then only names it), "password"?: string (for a password-protected Word document)}

commands.label: Save As
commands.params: {"path": string, "password"?: string, "markup"?: bool, "format"?: string (as file.save), "strict"?: bool (as file.save)}

commands.label: Export Page as PNG
commands.params: {"path": string, "page"?: n (1-based), "scale"?: px per pt, "markup"?: bool (the page with its comments in balloons beside it; default file.printMarkup), "strict"?: bool (refuse, writing nothing, if a character on the page can't be drawn or a picture is missing; see file.strictReport)}

commands.label: Properties
commands.params: {"title"?, "subject"?, "author"?, "keywords"?, "comments"?, "category"?, "custom"?: {name: string | {"value": string, "linkTarget"?: string | null} | null (removes)}}; text values and bookmark targets are at most 1 MiB; a string keeps an existing target, an object replaces it (omitted/null target unlinks)

commands.label: Protect Document
commands.params: {"mode": "none|readOnly|comments|trackedChanges"} (starting enforcement; "none" doesn't stop a protected document — use review.restrict {"stop": true})

commands.label: Recover Unsaved Documents
commands.params: {"restore"?: recoveryId, "discard"?: recoveryId, "refresh"?: true}; desktop only; returns {enabled,busy,documents,error}; restore loads asynchronously without a file path

commands.label: Rename Document
commands.params: {"name": string (document name; its extension is kept, so the name may be given with or without it)}

commands.label: Encrypt with Password
commands.params: {"password": string (Word documents are saved encrypted with it) | null or "" (saved unencrypted)}

commands.label: User Name
commands.params: {"name": string (author of new tracked changes and comments)}

commands.label: Remove Language Pack
commands.params: {"locale": string} — removes the installed pack. Opens nothing.

commands.label: Set as Default Language
commands.params: {"lang": "en-US|en-GB|pl-PL|nl-NL|…" (BCP 47)} — only the saved default proofing language, what future blank documents are written in, as Options › Language › Set as default does; the open document, the selection and the undo history don't change. Returns {"preferred": tag}.

commands.label: Print Markup
commands.params: {"value"?: bool (omit to toggle)} — PDFs, prints and copies show comments (balloons beside each page; a list at the end of HTML, Markdown and text) and tracked changes

commands.label: Find
commands.params: {"text": string, "matchCase"?: bool, "wholeWord"?: bool, "matchPrefix"?: bool, "matchSuffix"?: bool, "ignorePunct"?: bool, "ignoreSpace"?: bool, "wildcards"?: bool, "special"?: bool (^p ^t ^# … codes, default true), "regex"?: bool}

commands.label: Go To
commands.params: {"page"?: n, "pageBy"?: int (pages forward, negative back, from the caret's page), "bookmark"?: string (selects its text), "paragraph"?: n}; none opens Find and Replace on its Go To tab

commands.label: Replace All
commands.params: {"text": string, "with": string (^p ^t ^& ^c …; \\1 with wildcards; with regex also $1 ${n} ${name} $0 $$ \\1 \\n (paragraph mark) \\t), …options of edit.find}

commands.label: Add Object to Selection
commands.params: {"pos"?: Pos, "index"?: n, "objects"?: [Pos | n]}  (n: its Selection Pane index; with no object selected yet, the first one becomes the selection)

commands.label: Add Font…
commands.params: {"path"?: string, "data"?: base64, "name"?: string (file name for "data")} — a TTF, OTF, TTC, WOFF or WOFF2 file; none: pick a file

commands.label: Underline Color
commands.params: {"color": "RRGGBB" | "auto"} (the underline's own colour; "auto" follows the text colour)

commands.label: Keep Lines Together
commands.category: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Keep with Next
commands.category: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Page Break Before
commands.category: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: Widow/Orphan Control
commands.category: Home › Paragraph › Line and Page Breaks

commands.label: List Definition
commands.params: {"num"?: list id (default: the caret's list)} → {"num", "levels": [as list.define]}

commands.label: Delete Style
commands.params: {"style": string (name or id; custom styles only)}

commands.label: Show or Hide Style
commands.params: {"style": string, "gallery"?: bool (Styles gallery, w:qFormat), "hidden"?: bool (hidden from style lists, w:semiHidden)}

commands.label: Footer
commands.params: {"page"?: number (0-based; default: the caret's section)} — the footer that page shows, created if it has none, with the caret in it

commands.label: Header
commands.params: {"page"?: number (0-based; default: the caret's section)} — the header that page shows, created if it has none, with the caret in it

commands.label: Edit Footer
commands.params: {"page"?: number (0-based: the footer that page shows, created if it has none)}

commands.label: Edit Header
commands.params: {"page"?: number (0-based: the header that page shows, created if it has none)}

commands.label: Drawing Canvas
commands.params: {"width"?: pt (default 432 = 6"), "height"?: pt (default 216 = 3"), "fill"?: "RRGGBB", "outline"?: "RRGGBB"}  (in line with text at the caret; it stays selected, so the next Pictures, Shapes or Text Box goes inside it)

commands.label: Icons
commands.params: {"id"?: string (omit to list the library), "color"?: "RRGGBB", "size"?: pt, "query"?: string, "category"?: string}

commands.label: Shapes
commands.params: {"kind": "rectangle|roundedRectangle|ellipse|triangle|diamond|line|arrow|star|heart|straightConnector|elbowConnector|curvedConnector", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "fill"?: "RRGGBB", "stroke"?: "RRGGBB", "arrow"?: "none"|"start"|"end"|"both" (lines and connectors; glue a connector's ends with shape.connect)}

commands.label: Cross-reference
commands.params: {"to": "heading|bookmark|figure|table|equation|label:<Name> (a caption label of your own)", "target": string (text / name / number), "show"?: "text|page|number|aboveBelow"} or {} to list targets

commands.label: Convert Text to Table
commands.params: {"separator"?: "tab|comma|paragraph|other", "char"?: string (with other), "columns"?: n, "autofit"?: "initial|fixed|contents|window", "width"?: pt (initial column width, 0 = Auto, at most 1584)}

commands.label: Drop Cap
commands.params: {"position"?: "none"|"dropped"|"margin" (default dropped), "lines"?: 1..10 (default 3; 0 = none), "distance"?: pt from the text (0..1584, default 0), "font"?: family (omit for the text's font), "keep"?: bool (true: each selected paragraph that has a drop cap keeps its own lines, distance and font unless given here)}

commands.label: AutoText
commands.params: {"save"?: name, "in"?: "document", "insert"?: name, "delete"?: name} → {"parts": names, "document": the document's AutoText}

commands.label: Move or Resize
commands.params: {"width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "x"?: pt, "y"?: pt, "page"?: n, "to"?: Pos}  (x/y: the top-left on page `page` (0-based, default its page); moving an inline object by x/y floats it. to: an In Line with Text object moves to that text position and stays inline, as a drag does)

commands.label: Copy to
commands.params: {"x": pt, "y": pt, "page"?: n} | {"to": Pos}  (Ctrl+drag: a copy of the selected object lands with its top-left there, or an In Line with Text one at the text position `to`, and is selected; the original and the clipboard stay as they were)

commands.label: Group
commands.params: {}  (groups the selected pictures, shapes and text boxes: the selected one plus those added with select.addObject)

commands.label: Move with Text
commands.params: {"value": bool}  (true: Move with Text, the floating object's vertical position follows its paragraph; false: Fix Position on Page. It stays where it is)

commands.label: Hyphenation
commands.params: {"value"?: bool (automatic; toggles when nothing is given), "zone"?: pt, "caps"?: bool (hyphenate words in capitals), "limit"?: n (consecutive hyphens, 0 = no limit)}

commands.label: Right-to-Left Section
commands.params: {"value"?: bool} (true: the section's columns run right to left; without a value it toggles)

commands.label: Size
commands.params: {"name"?: "Letter|Legal|A4|…", "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt} (each side clamped to 7.2–1584 pt, 0.1–22 in; the section keeps its orientation)

commands.label: Manual Hyphenation
commands.params: {"from"?: Pos (default: the caret)} → the next word at a line end that could be hyphenated: {"word", "pos", "points": [char index], "suggest": char index} or {"done": true}

commands.label: Vertical Alignment
commands.params: {"value": "top|center|justify|bottom"} (also both|justified; anything else is top). Justified shares each page's spare room between its paragraphs and tables

commands.label: Finish & Merge
commands.params: {"path"?: string (save the merged document), "records"?: "all|current" (current: the previewed record; default all, or from/to), "from"?: n, "to"?: n (record numbers, 1 = the first)}

commands.label: Filter Recipients
commands.category: Mailings › Start Mail Merge › Edit Recipient List

commands.label: Sort Recipients
commands.category: Mailings › Start Mail Merge › Edit Recipient List
commands.params: {"sort"?: [{"field": string, "descending"?: bool}]} | {"field": string, "descending"?: bool} (no params: the list's own order)

commands.label: Undo Actions
commands.params: {"count": n (1 = the newest step, like edit.undo; n undoes the newest n steps at once; at most the undo depth)}

commands.label: Update Field
commands.params: {"all"?: bool (the body and every header, footer, note and text box, wherever the caret is; default: the story the caret is in)}

commands.label: Manage Sources
commands.params: {"add"?: Source, "remove"?: tag, "import"?: path (a Word bibliography file, `b:Sources` / `Sources.xml`)} → list

commands.label: Insert Endnote
commands.params: {"text"?: string, "mark"?: string (a custom mark instead of the number)}

commands.label: Insert Footnote
commands.params: {"text"?: string, "mark"?: string (a custom mark instead of the number)}

commands.label: Delete
commands.params: {"id"?: non-negative JSON integer (omit to use the caret), "all"?: bool}

commands.label: Spelling & Grammar
commands.params: {"wrap"?: bool (default true; false stops at the end of the current story)}

commands.label: Alt Text
commands.params: {"text"?: string, "title"?: string, "decorative"?: bool} (the selected picture, shape, text box, group or chart)

commands.label: Expand
commands.params: {"by"?: pt (default 36)}  (grows the frame right and down; at least enough to show every member)

commands.label: Fit
commands.params: {}  (shrinks the selected canvas's frame to its drawing: the members move to its top-left corner)

commands.label: Canvas Member
commands.params: {"index": n, "x"?: pt, "y"?: pt, "width"?: pt, "height"?: pt, "delete"?: bool}  (moves, resizes or removes member `index` of the selected canvas; x/y from the canvas's top-left; with no change, returns the members)

commands.label: Scale Drawing
commands.params: {"factor": number (0.1–10)}  (scales the frame and every member together)

commands.label: Select Canvas Member
commands.params: {"index": n | null}  (picks member `index` of the selected drawing canvas on its own: Shape Format, Size, Rotate, Alt Text, Delete, Cut and Copy then act on it, and Move or Resize and Nudge move it inside the canvas; null: the canvas itself again)

commands.label: Create Link
commands.params: {"target": Pos | n}  (the empty text box the selected box's text continues in: its position, or its Selection Pane index)

commands.label: Transform
commands.params: {"preset": "textArchUp"|"textArchDown"|"textCircle"|"textWave1"|"textSlantUp"|"textSlantDown"|"textInflate"|"textDeflate"|"textChevron"|"textChevronInverted"|"textTriangle"|"textTriangleInverted"|… (any DrawingML preset text warp)|"none", "adj"?: n (the preset's adjust value)}

commands.label: Text Pane
commands.params: {"value"?: bool} (no value: show or hide the Text Pane)

commands.label: Missing Fonts
commands.params: {} → {"missing": [{"font": string, "shownAs": [string] (the families drawn instead), "metricCompatible": bool (its substitute measures like the font)}]} — the text the current view shows

commands.label: Text Direction
commands.params: {"value"?: "horizontal|down|up"} (default: the next direction after the caret cell's, like Word's button)

commands.label: Sort
commands.params: {"column"?: non-negative JSON integer (0-based, default 0; must name a column in the table), "descending"?: bool, "header"?: bool}

commands.label: Convert to Text
commands.params: {"separator"?: "tab|comma|paragraph|other", "char"?: string (with other)} (the selected rows, or the whole table)

commands.label: Split Cells
commands.params: {"columns"?: n (2), "rows"?: n (1), "mergeFirst"?: bool (true: several selected cells are merged first)}

commands.label: Insert Row or Column by Clicking
Search
commands.params: {"query"?: string} → {matches: [{id, label, location, shortcut}]} (every word of the query in the label, location or id; at most 50); no query opens the Search box

commands.label: Templates and Add-ins
commands.params: {} → {"template": path|null, "linkStyles": bool} (from the ribbon, the app shows the dialog)

commands.label: Rename Style
commands.params: {"style": string (name or id; custom styles only), "name": string}

commands.label: View Side by Side
commands.params: {"value"?: bool, "window"?: id of the other window (optional when one other window is open)}

commands.label: Switch Windows
commands.params: {"id"?: n (make this open document the active one), "window"?: n (make this open window the active one)} → {"documents": [{"id", "title", "path", "dirty", "active"}]} in the order they were opened
